notes:
OCRelay 1.0.84

What's new

• New study: NM Renal (Lasix renogram) — half-time and split renal function, with an obstruction advisory shown per kidney in the review panel.

• UE Arterial now supports a Unilateral mode for single-arm studies, matching LE Arterial.

• Fixed a bug where selecting UE Arterial → Unilateral (or certain other single-side studies) could silently open the wrong study's review panel, and Recall Last could appear to replay an old result.

• Recall Last now shows the original capture time in the review panel header, so it's always clear whether you're looking at a fresh capture or a recalled one.
